title: Negotiations on drug prices in China and health insurance sustainability: retrospective and future trends
core_idea: This study analyzes China's drug price negotiation process from 2017 to 2023 to assess its effects on drug pricing—with emphasis on innovative and high-cost therapies—and to explore implications for treatment access, healthcare affordability, and the financial sustainability of the health insurance system, using public NHSA data and a mixed quantitative–qualitative approach.
tldr: Examines 2017–2023 Chinese drug price negotiations and their implications for pricing, access, affordability, and health insurance sustainability using NHSA data and mixed methods, focusing on high-cost and innovative therapies.
